description: Query any Washington, DC ArcGIS layer by service path + layer id. Full ArcGIS query: where, out_fields, order_by, limit. Use dc_layers to find a service/layer, or dc_recent for the common ones. Epoch dates are converted to ISO.

layer.description: Layer id within the service (from dc_layers), e.g. 39.

service.description: ArcGIS service path, e.g. "FEEDS/MPD/MapServer" (or a short name: crime|service_requests|permits).

name: dc_query
title: Dc Query
